metadata.title: Vintage Soft-Focus Portrait with Heraldic Crest

recipe.visualDefinition: A 1970s-style soft-focus portrait of a woman in a dark green bow-tie blouse, positioned against a near-black background. A large bouquet of yellow and white chrysanthemums occupies the lower-left corner. Centered above the subject's head is a complex, illustrated heraldic crest featuring figures, a tree, and ribbon banners containing text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed away from the viewer toward the right frame edge.
Floral mass in the foreground balancing the subject's head in the upper right quadrant.
Ornate, bright crest acting as a central vertical anchor against the dark background.
Soft, diffused lighting creating a gentle transition between the subject and the shadows.
coreInvariants: Desaturated, earthy color palette dominated by forest green and ochre.
Symmetrical placement of the central graphic element.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-close portrait, subject shifted slightly to the right, occupying roughly 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow and gold heraldic crest centered at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright crest, moves down to the subject's face, follows the gaze right, then sweeps down to the bright flowers in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space surrounding the subject, emphasizing the intimate mood.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and forest green (background and clothing).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale yellow and cream (flowers and skin tones).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark background and the bright floral/crest elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or off-white

letterConstructionRules: Curved baselines following the arc of the ribbon banners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are condensed to fit within the narrow ribbon segments
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface style used within the crest to maintain heraldic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aged, classical feel of the crest lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus 1970s film portrait of a woman with feathered hair wearing a dark green pussy-bow blouse, looking off-camera. Lower left corner features a dense cluster of yellow chrysanthemums. Background is dark and moody with visible film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a centered, ornate heraldic crest above the woman's head. The crest should include a stylized tree, two figures playing instruments, and arched gold ribbons. Place serif text along the curve of the ribbons.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft and diffused?
Does the crest feel integrated rather than pasted on?
Are the flowers in the lower left corner?
Is the color palette muted and vintage?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text follows the ribbon's curve naturally.
Check that the soft focus doesn't blur the crest details excessively.
Verify the dark green of the blouse doesn't disappear into the background.
Confirm the composition feels weighted toward the bottom-left and top-right.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key 70s portrait with a high-contrast floral foreground and a centered, illustrative graphic element for a nostalgic, folk-pop aesthetic.
